sentinels.purpose: PARENT UNCHANGED. v1.0.0's own two committed files (the authority and its manifest) must be byte-identical before and after this amendment's merge and commit. Any diff falsifies append-only and must STOP the lane rather than be reconciled silently.

ARMED STAYS FALSE. WHAT_THIS_ARTIFACT_GRANTS_AND_WHEN.ARMED in v1.0.0 must read false in the tree this amendment produces. Any tree in which it reads true, without a materialized independent-certification verdict artifact committed alongside it, is a tree in which this reconciliation quietly armed a read authority it was explicitly told not to arm.

MERGE ANCESTRY. 6f747e86e0a3eb62d4db87fabe6b331cd4c4a7b2 must be an ancestor of the final committed HEAD of this branch. Absence means the reconciliation this amendment claims to have performed did not actually happen.

CANDIDATE BINDING HOLDS. The owner-ratification's CANDIDATE_BINDING.candidate_sha must equal v1.0.0's own AS_OF_PARENT_HEAD. If a re-derivation ever finds them unequal, OWNER_RATIFICATION_CONSUMED's cross-check is void and the amendment must not be relied upon without a fresh reconciliation.

AUTHORING ARM. The merge commit's parents include both the pre-merge PR #214 head (feadb429) and the advanced parent branch head (6f747e86), and git merge-base --is-ancestor 6f747e86 <final head> returns true.
AUTHORING ARM. The RNA-3 correction's parent_text_verbatim field, when compared character-for-character against v1.0.0's actual committed GAPS_NOT_CLOSED.gaps[3] object, matches exactly.

AUTHORING ARM. The owner-ratification's blob_sha (27c58a8c0a8294e6883d07e277cd115ffe09b8dc) re-derives via git rev-parse HEAD:<path> at the final committed head, and its CANDIDATE_BINDING.candidate_sha (2d25b65c) equals v1.0.0's AS_OF_PARENT_HEAD.

AUTHORING ARM. The read-set partition recomputed directly from the merged tree's raw file content (not from v1.0.0's own self_check) equals: 9 reads, 18 nodes, 12 with reads / 6 without, PLANE-V=6/PLANE-G=7/PLANE-X=2, 42 failure tokens.
AUTHORING ARM. Both new documents (this amendment and its manifest amendment) parse as JSON and the manifest amendment validates against docs/ops/ods/UELLIX_TEST_MANIFEST_SCHEMA_v1.0.0.json.

AUTHORING ARM. git grep for the string INFRA_CONTROL_PLANE_READ_AUTHORITY_IC across the full tree, excluding this lane's own four files, returns nothing -- corroborating PRIOR_CERTIFICATION_STATUS.materialization_check.

negative_controls.description: RNA-3's CORRECTION IS REFUSED AS AUTHORIZATION FOR M-8 OR M-9. Any reading of SUPERSEDED_PARENT_CLAUSES.corrections[0] that treats RBD-1/RBD-2 being ratified as DN-7 or DN-10 being executable must be REFUSED. The correction states an owner decision is settled; it states nothing about either mutation's prestate, confirmation, verification, or rollback.

THE REPORTED IC IS REFUSED AS GROUNDS TO SET ARMED = TRUE. Any commit that sets WHAT_THIS_ARTIFACT_GRANTS_AND_WHEN.ARMED to true, citing PRIOR_CERTIFICATION_STATUS.reported_verdict as its basis, without a materialized independent-certification verdict artifact also present in the tree, must be REFUSED.

A REBASE OR FORCE-PUSH IN PLACE OF THE MERGE IS REFUSED. Any reconciliation that rewrites this branch's history instead of merging the advanced parent non-destructively must be REFUSED, per the directing mission's explicit prohibition and per CLAUDE.md's git branch discipline.

992 COMMITS (OR ANY OTHER RATIFICATION-CARRIED NUMBER) CITED AS THIS AUTHORITY'S OWN MEASURED FACT IS REFUSED. Any read's evidence_record populated with a commit-distance or other figure copied from the owner-ratification record, rather than freshly re-derived by the read itself when executed, must be REFUSED.

A MISMATCHED CANDIDATE_BINDING IS REFUSED. If a future re-derivation finds the ratification's CANDIDATE_BINDING.candidate_sha no longer equal to v1.0.0's AS_OF_PARENT_HEAD (for instance because v1.0.0 itself is later superseded by a v1.0.2), citing OWNER_RATIFICATION_CONSUMED as still valid without a fresh cross-check must be REFUSED with STOP_RATIFICATION_BINDING_MISMATCH.

A CHANGED READ ATTRIBUTED TO THIS RECONCILIATION IS REFUSED. Any addition, removal, or scope change to V-R1..V-R4, G-R1..G-R4, or X-R1, committed as part of this amendment or attributed to it, must be REFUSED. RBD_CONSEQUENCES_CARRIED_FORWARD states explicitly that neither ratified decision adds, removes, or loosens any read requirement.

mutation_controls.description: Delete SUPERSEDED_PARENT_CLAUSES entirely, leaving v1.0.0's stale RNA-3 as the only text on RBD-1/RBD-2's status. Control NA-1 must still be POSABLE (the corrected text must exist to test against), and PA-3 must REDDEN (nothing to compare). If both stay green, the correction was never load-bearing.

Change WHAT_THIS_ARTIFACT_GRANTS_AND_WHEN.ARMED to true in v1.0.0 as part of this amendment's commit, with no materialized IC artifact added. Sentinel SEN-A2 and control NA-2 must both REDDEN. If either stays green, the reconciliation can arm the grant on a report alone.

Perform the parent reconciliation via git rebase instead of merge. Control NA-3 must REDDEN, and PA-2's ancestor check must fail differently (the pre-merge feadb429 commit would no longer be reachable by its original SHA). If it stays green, history rewriting on a shared branch went undetected.

Add a tenth read to READS in v1.0.0, or alter one existing read's field allowlist, as part of this amendment's write set. PA-5's recomputed partition must REDDEN against the recorded 9/18/12-6/6-7-2/42 baseline, and NA-6 must trigger. If both stay green, a scope change slipped in under a reconciliation label.

Change OWNER_RATIFICATION_CONSUMED.candidate_binding_cross_check.result to EQUAL without the two SHA values actually matching. PA-4 must REDDEN when independently re-derived. If it stays green, the cross-check is decorative.
